title: Pan-Seared Shrimp with Tunisian Crumble
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the sweetness of shrimp with the spiciness of Tunisian crumble.
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil and cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Serve the shrimp with a spoonful of Tunisian crumble on top.
Garnish with crumbly for added crunch.
